title: I18nConfiguration
description: Language preferences for the checkout page. Read Localisation for details.

default_language.description: Default language is used for displaying the page. Any customer language choice would override this option

fallback_language.description: Fallback language is used when DEFAULT_LANGUAGE is invalid. Any customer language choice would override this option

show_language_options.description: Indicates whether a language selection option should be shown to the customer on the Checkout page or not
